context.name: TestRouteContext
context.doc: The invocation, roots and re-entry of the test script that its route group functions receive instead of the script instance.
context.init: { invocation: this.invocation, repoRoot: this.repoRoot, root: this.root, run: (routeSegments) => this.run(routeSegments) }

groups.doc: The fixture placement, original control, target execution and Nx owner routes of the test script.
groups.name: runFixtureAndNxRoutes
groups.fdoc: Runs the fixture placement, original control, target execution and Nx owner routes; true when one matched.

groups.doc: The runtime actor, artifact command, Cargo search path, Nx inference and native source routes of the test script.
groups.name: runRuntimeAndPathRoutes
groups.fdoc: Runs the generator, runtime, artifact, Cargo, build discovery, Nx inference and ownership routes; true when one matched.

groups.doc: The build surface, dependency direction and canonical execution routes of the test script.
groups.name: runBuildAndDirectionRoutes
groups.fdoc: Runs the build surface, native dependency, canonical JSON, mutation authority, direction and corpus routes; true when one matched.

groups.doc: The Go dispatch, source topology and root source law routes of the test script.
groups.name: runSourceTopologyRoutes
groups.fdoc: Runs the runtime corpus, Go dispatch, catalog, topology, platform and root source routes; true when one matched.

groups.doc: The crate tree, family, publication and ownership law routes of the test script.
groups.name: runOwnershipLawRoutes
groups.fdoc: Runs the crate tree, mutation family, publication, configuration and source ownership routes; true when one matched.

groups.doc: The path statute, mutation source, reference and authority routes of the test script.
groups.name: runReferenceAuthorityRoutes
groups.fdoc: Runs the path statute, mutation source, provider, reference and recovery authority routes; true when one matched.

groups.doc: The README source, divergence callback, verification and mutation witness routes of the test script.
groups.name: runReadmeAndMutationRoutes
groups.fdoc: Runs the README authority, divergence callback, source service, regeneration and mutation witness routes; true when one matched.
